title: Update lichen-oscore deps for zeroize on hmac/hkdf/sha2/aes
description: Add zeroize features to Cargo.toml to enable ZeroizeOnDrop on owned state in SHA, HMAC, HKDF, AES. Update any wrappers in lichen-crypto (or create if missing) or in oscore/edhoc. Add compile-time assertions for types implementing ZeroizeOnDrop where used. Extend tests for zeroization. After changes run 3 independent codereview passes using review commands. Fix ALL findings. Close only after all done and 3 clean passes.
close_reason: Zeroize features enabled on aes/hmac/sha2 direct deps in lichen-oscore (oscore crate already enables them transitively; verified against its manifest); sha2/zeroize for EDHOC transcript. Compile-time assertions in new zeroize_asserts.rs prove Context:Zeroize, Sha256/Aes128/CtOutput<HmacSha256>:ZeroizeOnDrop for the resolved lockfile versions (hkdf 0.13/ccm 0.5 have no zeroize feature - documented). 4 type-level/drop-path tests added. cargo check/clippy -D warnings/test/fmt all clean, no_std verified. 3-perspective wave review found no P0-P2; follow-ups filed as beads (orphaned provisioning.rs, upstream zeroize gaps, dup-version guard).
